0022600005.text: Both the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons with this regular-season game, which the Lakers host. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting, on April 9, 2026 in San Francisco, ended in a 119-103 Lakers win. Lakers Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr and Collin Sexton are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, all listed as out, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win.
